logo.visual_identity: English horizontal Northstar wordmark with the layered orange-and-cyan starburst, NORTHSTAR, and DESIGN SCHOOL.

hero.visual_identity: Portrait two-section collage: sketch critique and sculpture busts above; workshop audience below; cyan rail; VISITOR PASS; PORTFOLIO TOUR; navy divider; STUDIO HALL / OPEN DAY footer.

background.visual_identity: Cream blueprint grid with navy top band, orange upper-right diagonal, thin orange left rule, cyan square grid, and pale cyan lower-right circle.

brand_rules.logo_treatment: Do not crop, stretch, recolor, redraw, or omit descriptor.
brand_rules.hero_required_visibility: Both photo sections and at least two identifying campaign cues remain visible.
brand_rules.background_treatment: Use full bleed and do not recolor or flatten.
brand_rules.cta_treatment: Process orange field with navy type or visually equivalent approved high-contrast treatment.
brand_rules.contrast: Use a solid field or navy overlay when copy crosses bright photography; all required copy readable at phone size.

forbidden_content: July 12 • 10 AM-2 PM as the sole date-time line without the final schedule package
Spanish wordmark or Spanish campaign labels
legacy crest or stacked legacy logo
asset IDs, package IDs, filenames, approval notes, status records, source list, rule summary

source_resolution.platform_rule: Use the unique Instagram / Story event ad / Paid / US-EN profile whose latest pre-freeze revision is Active and whose effective window includes launch.
source_resolution.activation_rule: Use the matching OSD26 / IG-STORY-PAID / US-EN activation package whose latest status at or before freeze is Approved, not withdrawn, and valid on launch.
source_resolution.session_rule: Use the matching OSD26 / STUDIO-HALL / US-EN session package whose latest status at or before freeze is Active, not withdrawn, and valid on launch.
source_resolution.precedence_rule: Activation and session package fields override conflicting base-brief values.
